plugin.name: Social Signal Stream
plugin.description: Real-time social-signal input from a webcam via the SocialSignalStream service. Streams head pose, mouth state, facial expression, gaze, blinks, nod/shake gestures, body lean, smile sub-classification (Duchenne, masking, contempt), eyebrow action units, hand-face self-touch and turn context into SceneFlow variables at up to 30 FPS.

required.name: sss_streaming
required.description: SceneFlow variable: camera frames are arriving (Bool)

optional.name: ws_url
optional.description: WebSocket URL of the SocialSignalStream feature stream

optional.name: http_url
optional.description: Base URL of the SocialSignalStream REST API used by the start and calibrate_gaze actions. Empty = derived from ws_url.

optional.name: auto_start
optional.description: If true, start the camera pipeline on connect (POST /start) so no browser interaction is needed

optional.name: device_index
optional.description: Camera device index used by auto_start and by the start action

optional.name: capture_width
optional.description: Capture width in pixels used by auto_start and by the start action

optional.name: capture_height
optional.description: Capture height in pixels used by auto_start and by the start action

optional.name: reconnect_delay_ms
optional.description: Reconnect delay in ms after connection loss

optional.name: update_interval_ms
optional.description: Minimum interval in ms between updates of the continuous signals. Nod, shake and blink events are exempt and always fire on the frame they occur. Lower = more responsive, higher = less interpreter load.

optional.name: angle_deadband
optional.description: Minimum change in degrees before an angle variable (head pose, lean, blink rate) is rewritten

optional.name: score_deadband
optional.description: Minimum change before a normalised 0-1 variable (gaze, blendshape scores, confidences) is rewritten

optional.name: write_when_invalid
optional.description: If true, keep writing feature variables while no face is detected. Default false: only sss_face_visible is updated, so the last measured values are held instead of falling back to defaults.

optional.name: variable_timeout_ms
optional.description: How long after launch the plugin keeps looking for a missing SceneFlow variable before switching that signal off for the run

optional.name: stream_timeout_ms
optional.description: Time in ms without a frame after which sss_streaming is set to false

commands.name: start
commands.description: Selects a capture device and starts the pipeline (POST /start), the same step the SocialSignalStream browser UI performs. Without it the service idles and no frames arrive. Not needed when auto_start is enabled.

params.name: device_index
params.description: Camera index; defaults to the device_index plugin setting

params.name: width
params.description: Capture width in pixels; defaults to the capture_width plugin setting

params.name: height
params.description: Capture height in pixels; defaults to the capture_height plugin setting

commands.name: calibrate_gaze
commands.summary: Calibrate the gaze centre on the current head position
commands.description: Collects ~2 s of samples and takes them as the neutral gaze direction, which removes the head-pitch baseline from gaze_x/gaze_y. Trigger it while the person looks straight at the camera, for example during a welcome scene.

commands.name: patch
commands.summary: Change a SocialSignalStream setting at runtime
commands.description: Sends a hot config patch over the feature WebSocket, applied without restarting the service. Use the dotted key from the SocialSignalStream config, for example key='mouth.mar_open_threshold' value='0.35' or key='nod.min_amplitude_deg' value='4.0'.

params.name: value
params.description: New value. Numbers and true/false are sent as such, everything else as text.

commands.name: recording_start
commands.summary: Start recording video and features on the SocialSignalStream host
commands.description: Writes the session video plus a features.csv on the machine running SocialSignalStream. Nothing is transferred to VSM; the flow only receives the session id in sss_recording_session, which is what you use later to match a run against its recording. By default the session is a marked one, which also writes a prompts.csv on the recording clock and makes the mark action usable.

params.name: marks
params.description: true (default) records a marked session that the mark action can stamp into. Set false for a plain recording.

params.name: scenarios
params.description: Comma-separated scenario ids from the SocialSignalStream scenario list, when the session follows a predefined sequence. Leave empty to mark with your own ids.

params.name: lang
params.description: Session language code, en or de (default en). Only used for a marked session.

commands.name: recording_stop
commands.summary: Stop the running recording and encode it
commands.description: Closes the session files and starts encoding the video on the SocialSignalStream host. Encoding continues in the background there, so the flow does not wait for it.

commands.name: mark
commands.summary: Stamp a moment into the running recording
commands.description: Adds a row to the recording's prompts.csv with start and end times on the recording clock, so what the agent was doing lines up with the measured signals when the session is reviewed. Requires a session started with marks enabled. Each mark ends the previous one, so the timeline is a sequence of intervals rather than points.

params.name: id
params.description: Identifier of what is happening now, e.g. the node or scene name

params.name: type
params.description: Kind of moment, e.g. question, instruction, pause

params.name: label
params.description: Behaviour expected here, used to pre-fill labels at review time (default none)

params.name: text
params.description: What was said or shown, for context in the review UI
